title: nats-consumer
description: What a consumer binds to: a stream, a durable name, and the subject it filters. Durable by name, because a consumer that forgets its position on restart replays or loses whatever arrived while it was gone.

stream.description: The stream to consume from. It exists already: a service does not create the stream it reads.

durable.description: The durable consumer name. Shared by every replica of this component, which is what makes them one consumer group rather than several.

subject.description: Filter the stream to this subject. Unset consumes everything the stream holds.
